limitations: All source positions are examined against the supplied screenshots, but only visible supplied features are compared; this is not a full accuracy measure.
205 positions lack separately visible reference suffix tags; these suffixes are not individually externally confirmed. The three מצותן occurrences retain form-level 3mp evidence only.
276 differences include lemma/root conventions, word-class and segmentation policies, vocalization conflicts and unresolved questions; they are not 276 demonstrated errors.
One source-only word and five wording variants are tracked separately from morphology. Duplicated screenshot 8:8 is counted once.
